I'm Peyman Kor - a Data Scientist and Machine Learning/AI Researcher passionate about helping businesses unlock the potential of Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI.

Originally from [Bandar Torkaman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bandar_Torkaman){target="_blank"} in northern Iran, I'm now based in Norway, completing my Ph.D. in Reinforcement Learning. My current research explores Agentic AI workflows and Generative AI models for process optimization and automation.

My doctoral work focuses on Reinforcement Learning, investigating both classical approaches like [Q-learning](https://www.mdpi.com/1999-4893/17/9/400){target="_blank"} and innovative applications in generative AI, such as [Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback](https://github.com/Peymankor/RLHF/blob/main/main.pdf){target="_blank"}.

Previously, I studied at the Technical University of Denmark and worked on diverse computational projects. I hold an M.Sc in Engineering from the University of Stavanger, specializing [developing practical ML solutions for real-world problems](https://bookdown.org/kor_peyman/masterthesisuis/){target="_blank"}.

I'm actively engaged on [GitHub](https://github.com/Peymankor){target="_blank"} and regularly share research insights through my blog. My passion lies in solving complex technical problems and collaborating with innovative teams.
